text: mst_fit() fits binding model Fnorm values. Use .fit RNA separately: ’s one row per RNA. n number capillaries fitted sigma scatter points around curve. warning tells us one fit failed: NEAT1-fl’s fit empty (NULL). ’ll see plot , NEAT1-fl’s Fnorm barely changes concentration, binding curve fit. failed fit never error, one bad group won’t stop others fitted. two models: model = "kd" (default) fits standard 1:1 binding model, taking account concentration fluorescent target. model = "hill" fits Hill equation, giving EC50 Hill coefficient, cooperative binding. default, Kd model estimates target concentration . know , setting gives reliable Kd, example mst_fit(fnorm, target_concentration = 50e-9, .= target). fit column holds fitted models. Get fitted values mst_coefs(): row one parameter (term) one fit, estimate, standard error 95% confidence interval. get just Kds, nM: atpH-fl binds Kd around 13 nM, matching value MO.Affinity Analysis gives data. title: Fit binding models to dose-response data — mst_fit
text: Kd model describes 1:1 binding ligand target, accounting depletion free ligand: $$f = \frac{c + c_T + K_d - \sqrt{(c + c_T + K_d)^2 - 4 c c_T}}{2 c_T}$$ $$y = U + (B - U) f$$ \(c\) ligand concentration, \(c_T\) target concentration, \(f\) fraction target bound, \(U\) \(B\) responses unbound bound states. Hill model describes cooperative binding: $$y = U + \frac{B - U}{1 + (EC_{50} / c)^n}$$
